rule_catalog.CG-EVENT-IDENTITY: A complete event has a source event type, minimal contiguous trigger, typed arguments, required nested event references, and event-local modifiers.
rule_catalog.CG-CLOSED-TYPES: Use only a listed Cancer Genetics source event type and preserve its explicit polarity; Regulation is used when direction is not explicit.
rule_catalog.CG-TRIGGER: The trigger must be the minimal exact contiguous source span expressing the event.
rule_catalog.CG-ROLES: Theme undergoes the primary effect, Cause is causally active, Participant is used only when no more specific supported role applies, and location roles require explicit location semantics.
rule_catalog.CG-NESTING: When an argument is itself an event, preserve the event-to-event reference and do not flatten it into one of the nested event's entities.
rule_catalog.CG-MODIFIER: NEGATED or SPECULATIVE applies only when source wording modifies that exact event.
rule_catalog.CG-VERIFICATION: ENTAILED requires PASS for event type, trigger, participants, roles, nesting, modifier, and evidence; general plausibility is insufficient.
rule_catalog.CG-GOLD-CREDIT: Benchmark credit requires equality with a complete public-gold event; source-supported extras receive no benchmark credit.
rule_catalog.CG-DEPENDENCY: An accepted event is structurally unusable when a required nested argument points to a V2 event whose preserved verifier verdict is not ENTAILED.
